correctness.rationale: For all h>=2,m>=1, a source one induces a contiguous output interval. Interior one-runs bounded by zeros force first/last source ones and h-bounded intermediate gaps; boundary one-runs are h-zero-avoiding binary patterns. This gives the explicit product of every preimage list, the image feasibility constraint, and unique-list classification; formal run grammars yield two rational generating functions. The roots are positive, simple, dominant and strictly ordered by direct substitution. A standalone checker separately computes exact image and singleton counts in 50 parameter cases, and all observed inverse lists agree. Finite tests are checks, not the universal proof.

They do not directly supply the rational all-h output-image and uniquely-invertible-output spectra nor the strict growth separation. The new statement is scoped to those global exact counts, avoiding an originality claim for generic inverse counting.
